messages.subject: Project Mosaic - completion statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Please find the completion statement attached for approval. The balance due from Marchwood on completion (10 October) is £19,020,080.97, being the price of £21,750,000 less the deposit of £2,175,000, less the apportioned rent the seller has collected in advance (£317,431, your share to the quarter end) and the rent deposits transferred to you (£221,500), plus your insurance apportionment, with a £25,000 service charge retention held by us pending the 2025 reconciliation.

SDLT of £1,077,000 is payable separately within 14 days of completion - we'll file and pay on your behalf. Please confirm you're happy and arrange for the completion monies to reach us by 10am on 10 October.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

This email is confidential and may be legally privileged. If you are not the intended recipient please delete it and notify the sender.
